summary: Frontend-only testing of new TroveCollectionTable under /komutanlar → MALİYET HESAPLAMA → Koleksiyon. All acceptance criteria PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: GRAND_TOTAL values are hardcoded constants (3.158.000 / 31.580 / 7.325 / 560) — they are not computed from COLLECTIONS. If any row value changes in future, totals will silently desync. Consider computing totals dynamically via reduce over COLLECTIONS.
Rare Coin label uses blue color (#3B82F6) same as RARE tier but 'Rare' in the coin taxonomy usually corresponds to a different palette; ensure this is intentional per design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: navigate to /, click [data-testid=header-login-btn] which goes to /login. Use inputs [data-testid=login-username] & [data-testid=login-password], then submit. After login, /komutanlar sidebar contains section MALİYET HESAPLAMA (raw Turkish key in data-testid) though label reads 'HESAPLA'. Category mh_koleksiyon renders TroveCollectionTable directly (no collapse card). All 11 type buttons, 16 cell values per type, and 4 grand-total blocks verified.
